name: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd
title: PNGS Reva Diamond Jewellery Ltd - 544718 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Branded diamond jewellery grew revenue 70% to INR439 crore in FY26 with 28% gross margin, but growth is largely gold-price driven (~INR55-60 crore surplus gold) and guidance of 25-30% is tied to gold prices, not capacity discipline.

triggers.label: FY26 SSG ~40% on gold price spike
triggers.quote: I achieved it 40% last year because there was a -- all of sudden shoot up of the gold prices.

triggers.label: FY27-28 top-line growth 25-30%
triggers.quote: I expect top-line growth also to get maintained around 25% to 30%.

triggers.label: Inventory turn 1.31x FY26
triggers.quote: Our inventory turn are at 1.31 times in FY26 as our store network continues to mature.

triggers.label: Asset-light EBO capex INR20-25 crore each
triggers.quote: it requires around INR20 crores to INR25 crores per EBO. So that expansion will have better numbers at lower capex.

guidance.quote: SSG, I am expecting around 25% to 30%, it will not be less than 25% to 30%.
I expect top-line growth also to get maintained around 25% to 30%.
out of these 14, 6 to 7 will take place in current financial year and remaining will be in next financial year.

red_flags.label: Growth driven by gold pass-through and surplus gold sales
red_flags.quote: out of that almost I think INR55 crores to INR60 crores is the -- around INR55 crores is a that surplus gold which we are receiving.

red_flags.label: Management rejects gold hedging; relies on natural hedge
red_flags.quote: hedging through MCX is possible, but there is no liquidity and cost of hedging is very high on the MCX.

red_flags.label: Related-party SIS dependence on parent P.N. Gadgil
red_flags.quote: Shop-in-Shop with our parent company, P.N. Gadgil & Sons and their ecosystem
